caveats: SDAHU has no independent healthy negative run (D2); its fp estimates share the calibration year.
Per-day flags are autocorrelated (weather); binomial p-values are optimistic (stated limitation).
All systems share the same simulated weather-year family - favorable to transfer; stated.
M1 alignment cells cover event-bearing days only (n stated per cell); count matrices cover the full raw calendar (L6).

engineering_truth._label: L21: the rhythm instrument (active-day fraction >= 0.95) was fixed after its first version (train-min) failed on a pre-registered target (SFPU 357/365); verdict threshold-insensitive across 0.90-0.97. Presence rows validate the projection, not the models; only the rhythm row is non-trivial.
